scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build:api
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:start:api" "npm run preview -w web"
scripts.test: cd backend && ./mvnw -q -B test && cd .. && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w web
